linux-strata-cuda-build (compile + link only, sm_86/sm_89, no GPU)
strata_geometry() refuses any geometry other than Flash-Next's at create_domain (kVersionMismatch)

validated_topologies: host-prefix -> worker -> worker -> host-tail (StrataDomain + fake engine, test_strata_wiring; no GPU)

limitations: CUDA engine compiled and linked (Linux, nvcc 12.0, sm_86/sm_89) but never run on a GPU; no Windows/MSVC build of the Strata backend exists in CI.
Only the Flash-Next geometry runs (H 2560, 4 residual streams, 24/2 heads x 256, expert ff 640, 10 active experts, 3:1 GDN/QSA); anything else fails at create_domain.

Per-role type limits: routed-expert down projections must be IQ4_NL, Q2_0, Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1 or Q8_0; GPU-resident expert gate/up cannot be Q3_K, Q5_1, Q6_K or IQ4_NL; token_embd cannot be F16, F32, Q6_K.
A routed-expert type outside Strata's GPU expert kernels would exit the process in the engine; ClusterLM now refuses it at expert_format() with a Status (ADR 0408), CUDA path unrun.
MTP drafts are greedy and verified as one-hot proposals: sampling stays exact, acceptance under sampling is lower than optimal (ADR 0203).
One session per domain: the MTP drafter is bound to session slot 0 and multi-session Verifiers were never run on a device.
Prefill goes through the Verifier in engine windows of at most 8 positions, not Strata's batched prompt path; a sub-batched window can only be committed whole.
A speculative window larger than the stage's local batch cannot be partially committed or aborted: the session is invalidated (placement keeps local_batch >= q).
The Father prefix must own layers 0..max(1, ple_layer) (PLE needs token ids); middle and tail stages are token-free.
describe_requirements reports container sizes before prepare and omits the tail's MTP drafter (~0.9 GB VRAM, loaded lazily at the first draft).
More than 2 Workers, a Host-only Strata plan and a 1-Worker Strata plan have no Strata test (1 Worker is covered by the reference backend only).
GPUs above compute capability 8.9 would run from PTX JIT; only sm_86 and sm_89 binaries are built and nothing is qualified.
Reference-backend tests cover 1 Worker (protocol level); no Strata test covers 1 Worker or Host-only.

local_micro_batch.description: Upper bound on the local sub-batch; effective value is min(this, VRAM-headroom choice, engine window 8) (ADR 0250). Below the profile's q, placement rejects the domain.

qualification.label: Supported, awaiting hardware qualification
qualification.notes: All GPU behaviour is pending. Fixture, fake-engine and reference-backend tests prove protocol, ownership and state-machine logic only; none raises a label.
